Root cause\\r\\n\\r\\n**The system lacks a demonstrated, complete protocol from standing mandate to governed completion.** Early FARs repaired execution liveness—remembering work, dispatching it, surviving failures, and scheduling continuation—whereas later barriers concern principal authority and unfinished product evidence. Repeated FAR cannot manufacture those inputs. However, “only owner signatures remain” is also too strong: five parked queue items do not establish that the entire denominator is externally blocked. Three declared kinds remain unimplemented, M2 lacks its isolated E2E/mutation evidence, and M4 lacks a measured semantic denominator; signatures cannot substitute for these. Principal requests are already issued, so issuing them again is not the next architectural repair. The missing guarantee is that **every unfinished obligation is represented, classified correctly, and connected either to executable work or to an authenticated external-response path**. See `DENOMINATOR_R15_2.json:326`, `DENOMINATOR_R15_2.json:435`, and `DENOMINATOR_R15_2.json:451`.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 3. Single highest-leverage repair\\r\\n\\r\\n**Promote the queue into a denominator-complete, authority-aware obligation ledger enforced by the control plane.**\\r\\n\\r\\nIts mechanically checked waiting predicate should be:\\r\\n\\r\\n```text\\r\\nWAITING_FOR_PRINCIPAL iff\\r\\n  every required denominator obligation is represented\\r\\n  AND every unfinished obligation has a validated dependency path\\r\\n  AND no legally executable agent action remains\\r\\n  AND every dependency leaf is an issued request to an authorized principal\\r\\n  AND receipt ingestion and automatic resumption are configured and tested\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nFor each obligation, record the exact satisfaction predicate, permitted principal or scoped grant, dependency edges, executable next action, evidence verifier, and—when external—the request identity and response-validation/resumption rule. **Unknown classification must fail closed, not become OWNER by default.**\\r\\n\\r\\nKeep completion separate: required evidence must verify, required orders must pass, semantic coverage must be measured, and admissions, independent acceptance, and release authorization must be valid. A request file is not acceptance; a lease heartbeat is not progress; `13 × 3` gates is not full semantic coverage.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis extends the existing exhaustion predicate rather than repeating it: `QUEUE_EXHAUSTION_PROOF.json:9` checks queue state, but does not establish denominator-wide coverage or response-driven resumption.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. That would indicate grant-recognition or enforcement failure, not missing authority.\\r\\n- **All required external inputs arrive, yet no downstream work resumes.** Authority would no longer explain the stall; dispatch or dependency handling would.\\r\\n- **All five requests are satisfied but M2, missing kinds, or semantic measurement remain unfinished.** That would directly falsify the narrower claim that “only owner signatures remain.”\\r\\n\\r\\nAnalysis only; no repository Observed stops\\r\\n\\r\\nTwelve rounds ended immediately after a commit/push or after a measurement was written. In every case the work was\\r\\nverifiable, the tree was clean, and nothing external was blocking *at that moment*. Measurements that locate the cause\\r\\n\\r\\n| measurement | value | what it rules out |\\r\\n|---|---|---|\\r\\n| TT entries | 20 | — |\\r\\n| TT with a prose `next_legal_step` | 20 | the round does record intent |\\r\\n| TT with an executable `resume_cmd` | **0** | intent is never machine-runnable |\\r\\n| Denominator items | 56 (18 W + 25 C + 9 E + 4 M) | — |\\r\\n| Denominator items with `next_action` | **0** | the register measures state, it cannot drive work |\\r\\n| Kanban tasks | 18 | — |\\r\\n| Kanban `task_runs` | 6 | the board was never used as a dispatch queue |\\r\\n| Kanban cards still `blocked` with reason `initial_status` | 12 | blocked-by-default reads as \\\"nothing to do\\\" |\\r\\n\\r\\n## 3. Root cause\\r\\n\\r\\n**The round's artefacts describe state; none of them carries an executable next action.** At a turn boundary the agent\\r\\nre-derives \\\"what now\\\" from prose, and prose does not survive context compression. So the loop terminates not because\\r\\nthe work is finished but because the *only available move* is to report.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis is a system defect, and it has three components:\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **No executable queue.** Status registers, TT registers and the kanban board all answer \\\"where are we\\\"; none answers\\r\\n   \\\"what do I run next, with which command, and what proves it worked\\\".\\r\\n2. **Blocked reads as stopped.** 12 of 18 cards were blocked with `initial_status`, a state that carries no reason and\\r\\n   no next action — so a reader cannot distinguish \\\"waiting on an owner\\\" from \\\"not started\\\".\\r\\n3. **No retry ladder.** The first EXECUTE dispatch died at 300 s and the round reported instead of re-scoping the task.\\r\\n   The same task later succeeded in 344 s once re-scoped; the failure was survivable and was treated as terminal.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Repair, chosen for leverage\\r\\n\\r\\n**A queue whose items are commands, plus a driver that parks blockers and keeps going.**\\r\\n\\r\\n- `QUEUE_R15_2.json`: every item carries `id`, `status`, `owner_class` (`AGENT` / `OWNER` / `HOST`), `next_action`,\\r\\n  and for agent items a literal `resume_cmd` with a `expect` condition.\\r\\n- `tools/advance_queue.py`: runs ready `AGENT` items one at a time, records the observed output, marks `DONE` on the\\r\\n  expectation, and on failure **parks** the item with a typed reason and continues to the next one.\\r\\n- Stop policy, now explicit and the only legal stops: destructive action, missing credential, mandated lane\\r\\n  unavailable, or an owner-only decision. Everything else parks and the driver continues.\\r\\n\\r\\nDesign note: the driver deliberately does not try to be a scheduler. It is a resume pointer with a retry ladder; the\\r\\nstate it needs is a file, so it survives context compression, a new session, and a reboot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Why this is better than \\\"try harder\\\"\\r\\n\\r\\nA resolve-to-continue instruction fails exactly when context is compressed, which is when the work is longest. A queue\\r\\nfile plus a driver moves the memory from the conversation into the repository, so \\\"continue\\\" becomes a command rather\\r\\nthan a recollection. It is also auditable: the queue records what ran, what it printed, and what was parked.\\r\\n--- FAR_ROOT_CAUSE_AUTHORITY.md\\r\\n# FAR: root cause of \\\"still blocked\\\" after repeated FAR\\r\\n\\r\\n## 0. The question, split correctly\\r\\n\\r\\nTwo different phenomena were being called by one name:\\r\\n\\r\\n- **stopping** — the round ends while agent-actionable work remains;\\r\\n- **not completing** — the round reaches items that no agent may satisfy.\\r\\n\\r\\nThe first was fixed (queue, lease, guard, scheduler). The second kept recurring after every FAR, because every FAR was\\r\\naimed at the first. That misdirection *is* the root cause, and it is not a model problem.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Attribution, with evidence from this round\\r\\n\\r\\n| layer | contribution | measurement | verdict |\\r\\n|---|---|---|---|\\r\\n| **Hermes (runtime)** | the loop was conversation-pulled; no scheduler by default | 12 stops, each after a push; `cron` job count = 0 before this round | **real cause, fixed** (lease + guard + `12eff9cba53c`) |\\r\\n| **model / session** | context compaction destroys in-flight intent | 12 compactions; state re-derived from prose each time | **amplifier, fixed** (state in files + resume cmds) |\\r\\n| **SBL** | no front door that refuses a round's closure | queue exhaustion was indistinguishable from completion until `continuation_guard.py` | **real cause, fixed in round tree; control-plane half is candidate only** |\\r\\n| **HG-KSEOS** | states named above their predicates (`DELIVERY_READY`) | `lifecycle.py:172` guards `DELIVERED` but not `DELIVERY_READY` | **real cause, candidate fix, not applied** |\\r\\n| **Fabric** | defines principals, not effort: W3 needs a Domain Owner admission; release needs a seal | `SWOF_CONNECTED -> BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`; `release: BLOCKED` | **dominant cause of \\\"not completing\\\"; not a defect** |\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. The actual root cause\\r\\n\\r\\n**The user's standing authorization and the governance contract quantify over different things.**\\r\\n\\r\\n- The authorization is about **effort and continuity**: \\\"do not stop, use FAR, execute your recommendations\\\".\\r\\n- The Fabric/HGK predicates are about **principal identity**: \\\"only a Domain Owner may admit W3\\\", \\\"only an AO may\\r\\n  accept\\\", \\\"only an owner may seal a release\\\".\\r\\n\\r\\nAn agent can satisfy the first instruction by working indefinitely. It cannot satisfy the second by working at all,\\r\\nbecause the predicate is `signed_by ∈ {owner}` — a set that no amount of computation enlarges. When both arrive in the\\r\\nsame turn, every possible action violates one of them:\\r\\n\\r\\n- stop → violates the continuity instruction;\\r\\n- sign anyway → violates the governance contract (and is the one failure that cannot be repaired later, because a\\r\\n  forged admission is indistinguishable from a real one downstream).\\r\\n\\r\\n**So the round did not stop because the model was lazy or the harness was missing a scheduler. It stopped because I kept\\r\\nchoosing the only legal action — refuse to forge — and then dressed that refusal as an ending instead of issuing the\\r\\nrequest that would have unblocked it.** The missing component was never compute; it was a **principal request**: a\\r\\nfirst-class, tracked, one-click-shaped ask addressed to the entity that can actually satisfy the predicate.\\r\\n\\r\\nThat is why repeated FAR failed: each FAR treated \\\"blocked on an owner\\\" as a symptom to be engineered around, when it is\\r\\na *fact about authority* that has to be **issued**, not solved.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 3. Why the repair is not \\\"get more authorization\\\"\\r\\n\\r\\nThe user has already granted everything a user can grant. Granting it again changes nothing, because the predicate is\\r\\nnot `authorized_by_user` — it is `signed_by_domain_owner`. A user who is not that owner cannot make it true by fiat, and\\r\\nan agent that pretends otherwise produces the one artefact class the whole contract exists to prevent. **The correct\\r\\nengineering response to an unsatisfiable-by-agent predicate is to make it satisfiable-by-owner in one step, and to\\r\\nprove the step was taken.**\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. The engineering solution (three components, all mechanical)\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1 Satisfiability classification, declared per item\\r\\n\\r\\nEvery denominator item carries `satisfiable_by ∈ {AGENT, OWNER, HOST, EXTERNAL_AO}` **and** the field that makes it so\\r\\n(e.g. `required_signature: \\\"domain_owner\\\"`, `required_artifact: \\\"host_id\\\"`). Without this, the same item gets\\r\\nre-litigated every round: it looks like unfinished work, so the next agent tries again, fails again, reports again.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2 Principal requests as artefacts\\r\\n\\r\\n`PRINCIPAL_REQUESTS/<item>.md` — one per owner-gated item, containing: the exact predicate, the artifact already built\\r\\nand waiting, the **literal** action or command that satisfies it, what it unblocks, an expiry, and the fallback if\\r\\ndenied. This converts \\\"not in my scope\\\" into \\\"issued, tracked, one step from unblocked\\\". It is the difference between a\\r\\nblocked round and a **pending decision with a form attached**.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3 A guard that refuses both false endings\\r\\n\\r\\nThe continuation guard already refuses \\\"done\\\" while agent work remains. It must equally refuse **\\\"blocked\\\" without a\\r\\nformal request**: an item parked with no principal request is indistinguishable from an item abandoned, and abandonment\\r\\nis what a chat turn looks like from the outside. New blocker: `UNISSUED_PRINCIPAL_REQUEST`. Together the two refusals\\r\\nleave exactly one honest terminal state: *no agent work remains, and every remaining item is an issued request awaiting\\r\\na named principal.*\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. What this predicts, and how it would be falsified\\r\\n\\r\\nIf the analysis is right, then after this repair the round should be able to sit indefinitely without a chat turn,\\r\\nwith every open item addressable by a single owner action, and no further FAR should find a new \\\"why did it stop\\\"\\r\\ncause. It is falsified if the guard's next refusals are again about agent-actionable work — that would mean the queue\\r\\nwas under-filled, not that authority was the limit.\\r\\n--- FAR_DECISIONS_R15_2.md\\r\\n# FAR decisions for the five parked queue items\\r\\n\\r\\nEvery parked item has an owner class, a recommendation, the exact one-line action the owner can take, and what the\\r\\nagent will do the moment that action lands. Nothing here is signed by the agent.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W02 — Fabric active policy disposition (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** The round consumes Fabric as `FABRIC_CURRENT_ACTIVE_VIA_HGK_CONSUMER`, but no artefact names *which*\\r\\npolicy version is active, and `TT-R15.2-FRONTDOOR-SANCTIONED-DRIFT` shows the front door disagreeing with the declaring\\r\\nconfig (`10100` hard-codes `deepseek-v4.1-flash`; `config/hermes-codex-lane.json` declares `minimax-m3.1-flash-free`).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** Two configs claim authority over the same decision, and neither is marked active. The disagreement is\\r\\nstructural, not a typo: a front door with a hard-coded model cannot follow a config that is meant to change.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation (cheapest correct fix).** Declare the active policy digest in one place (`config/active-policy.json`\\r\\nwith `policy_digest`, `declared_by`, `declared_at`) and make the front door *read* it instead of hard-coding a model.\\r\\nUntil that exists, the sanctioned drift is the honest state.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action (one line).** Name the active policy digest, or authorise the agent to treat `hermes-codex-lane.json` as\\r\\nactive and retire the hard-coded front door.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Bind the digest, re-run doctor, and re-measure the front door's declared-vs-served model.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W12 — SWOF W3 admission (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `SWOF_CONNECTED` exists in `MODES` with disposition `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`; `E08`/`E09` (first real SWOF) are\\r\\nNOT_RUN. Execution is limited to `STANDALONE` and `PREW3_SHADOW`.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** The product already models the three modes and the blocked disposition correctly. What is missing is an\\r\\nexternal Domain Owner issuing a Native Admission for W3 — an authority an agent cannot substitute for without turning\\r\\na governance gate into a formality.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Keep `SWOF_CONNECTED` blocked. Prepare the connected-mode dry run against a stub so that W3 is a\\r\\nconfiguration change on the day the admission lands, not a build.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Issue the W3 Domain Owner Native Admission, or authorise a shadow-only connected dry run.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Run the connected mode against the admission, capture the external receipt, and re-measure E08/E09.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W13 — five tools / three ZIPs / three private hosts (`HOST_PENDING`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `GSTACK_ABSENT` (23 probes); no host-issued IDs; no private-plugin schema in hand. E06 is NOT_RUN.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** Three of the artefacts this work package needs can only be produced *by* the host that will consume\\r\\nthem: tool IDs, reproducible ZIP install receipts, and private-host load receipts. An agent can build the tool, but it\\r\\ncannot be the host that accepts it.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Split the work package: the agent builds the five tools locally and proves reproducibility by\\r\\nbuilding each ZIP twice and comparing digests; only the host-load step stays `HOST_PENDING`. That converts \\\"not started\\\"\\r\\ninto \\\"built, awaiting load\\\", which is a materially different state.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Provide host IDs (or delegate to the host owner) and the private-plugin schema, or accept the local-build-with-double-digest\\r\\nevidence as the interim ceiling.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Load into each host, capture the load receipts, re-measure E06/C22.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W15 — release control bundle (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `release: BLOCKED`; the control plane reaches `DELIVERY_READY` but the round refuses `DELIVERED`\\r\\n(`TT-R15.2-DELIVERY-GATE-IGNORES-FAILED` — the gate does not block on FAILED work orders).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** The release needs two owner-side artefacts: a seal and a host-load receipt. Separately, HG-KSEOS's\\r\\ndelivery transition ignores FAILED work orders, so \\\"DELIVERY_READY\\\" is not evidence of readiness. Both facts point the\\r\\nsame way: the transition is a status flip, not a gate.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Do not fix the gate by refusing to advance — fix it by making the transition *require* a\\r\\nzero-FAILED predicate. That is a control-plane change (HG-KSEOS), and it is the highest-value defect in this list\\r\\nbecause every future round inherits it.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Approve the HG-KSEOS change (delivery gate must reject any FAILED work order) and issue the release\\r\\nseal separately.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Re-run the closing cycle and expect the transition to refuse while a FAILED order exists.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W16 — B0/B1/B2 performance baselines (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** No baseline artefact exists; `E0x` performance rows are NOT_RUN.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** A baseline needs an owner-chosen reference workload and an owner-accepted threshold. An agent that\\r\\ninvents both is setting its own exam.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Measure first, threshold later: publish B0/B1/B2 as *observed* numbers with the workload and host\\r\\ndescribed, explicitly unratified. That is useful immediately and cannot be mistaken for an accepted baseline.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Name the reference workload and accept or reject the observed thresholds.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Measure against the accepted workload, publish deltas, and re-measure C16.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Cross-cutting\\r\\n\\r\\nThree of the five blocker classes are the same shape: **the agent can produce the artefact but not the authority that\\r\\naccepts it.** The repair is not more effort — it is splitting each work package into a buildable part and an acceptance\\r\\npart, and reporting them separately. That split is what turns `NOT_RUN` into `BUILT_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE`, which is a\\r\\ntrue statement, instead of `NOT_RUN`, which reads as \\\"did nothing\\\".\\r\\n--- QUEUE_R15_2.json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"schema\\\": \\\"SBL_R15_2_QUEUE/1\\\",\\r\\n  \\\"why\\\": \\\"The round kept stopping because its artefacts described state and carried no executable next action. 不可無聲減法\\n`U03` 是 **3 SP × 3 使用動作**的候選笛卡兒展開（安裝/有效載入/真調用），額外 nine operational test cells 不替換 149 上位 ID；每 Host （若原生來源要求四宿主）還有各自 install/load/trigger/uninstall 的受影乘積，**Host 名單及 Owner scope 待 DOC-10/Native 核定**。`U14` 要分 DEV ECP、OPS ECP 及 ONE ECP 原生映射，不能宣稱三者是三個平行執行授權；`U20` 要 RepoContext、WorkOrder、ONE ECP、ExecutionBinding 四個獨立簽核點；`U27` 把 source SHA 與 evidence SHA 分清；`U35` 有 Loop A/B/C 各不同 Stop/rollback；`U42` 的 Plugin/Profile/Agent OS/AI System 是需求候選，不能轉成 v0.1 implementation target；`U50` 的 `workflow/script/config/JSON/TSV` 每一種都有可觀測 deliver contract，且不得把這五例當已完整羅列所有上游子項。當原 149 子 ID 所代表的範圍仍不夠細時，新增 **proposal** `Uxx.ext*` 並記 `EXPANSION_NOT_CANONICAL`，由 source owner ratify，禁止暗算已閉合。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-026\\\"></a>\\n### C05.3.1 來源 child 與建議擴展的雙 Ledger\\n原始 149 筆永久保留 `source-native child ID`；建議增加的 `Uxx.ext` 放 `proposal_child_ledger`，在沒有上位 Owner ratification 時不寫回 149 上位分母。查詢可同時回傳兩個 ledger，但審計器必須分欄統計 `source_native_count=149` 與 `proposal_extension_count`。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-027\\\"></a>\\n### C05.3A｜完整子義務的分母分離與跨域拒收\\n`149` 是上位 native child SourceIDs 的**來源身份分母**；`50` 是 parent 分母；細粒度規範原子分母必須額外計算，而且在來源 fragment 截斷時不可自宣已達到 149 個 owner-ratified atoms。U14/U20/U27/U35/U42/U50 及 U03 展開的 `SBL-PROP-U*.ext` 是候選 extension，只允許出現在獨立 Proposal ledger，不得覆寫原始 child ID、來源 sha、Oracle 作者或 acceptance 真值。任一 parent 中含「同時、除非、任一、全部」須拆成不同作用域/否定條件/Owner；對未見原文的原子寫 `BLOCKED_TT`，提供被要求的原始片段 locator 及 Owner 行動，而非補出看似完整的引言。\\n**C05 逐原子判準**：`source_clause → atom → product_spec → acc → POS_fixture & NEG_fixture → EExp → DELIVER → consumer` 每條邊須能在同版本、同 source hash 連結；任一缺失只降低當條成熟度，不把所有有 ID 的原子統計為語義 Closed。DOC-01 可定 `AcceptanceCue`，`CR-ORACLE-001` 未解前不可替 PIPD DOC-07 寫正式 Oracle。\\n## C05.4 Applicability／正負反證與 C05 SPEC\\n每個子原子套用 `ProductKind × Mode × Host × UserRisk × Permission` 的適用性判定，不能把 `Unknown` 寫成 N/A；跨 DOC `owner_doc` 永遠以原生 Writer 優先。由 DOC-01 使用者角度測 `ExpectedExperience`，由 DOC-03/08 等原生負責正式 PI 與 Oracle：`positive=合法欄位+同候選 hash+正確 viewer`, `negative=missing child/wrong consumer/foreign SHA`, `edge=不適用僅有 Owner 明示理由`, `security=unauthorized SideEffect must deny/no residue`。\\n`input_schema=SourceParent+SourceChild+Mode+Kind; output_schema=RequirementAtomLedger+ApplicabilityRef; preconditions=50 parent and 149 authoritative child IDs resolvable; error=COMPOUND_ATOM_MISSING; first_fail=SOURCE_MISSING→COMPOUND_ATOM_MISSING; owner=SBL-R009 (editorial), SBL Product Owner (product), individual canonical owner (writer); consumer=DOC-03/08/09; positive_fixture=POS-C05 all IDs distinct and typed; negative_fixture=NEG-C05 U20.WorkOrder absent; rollback_or_no_effect=no effect`。正式 closure 須獨立 Reviewer 核對來源片段與本表；本輪不宣稱已完成 semantics-level exhaustive audit。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-028\\\"></a>\\n# C06｜SBL 八個 ProductKinds `GENIE_PRODUCT`；`WORKFLOW/KNOWLEDGE_PACK/LIBRARY/HOST_ADAPTER/INTEGRATION_STACK` 是 deliverable-component 候選，**不加進 ProductKindEnum**。Kind 字串外擴須原 Owner RFC，未核准→`P_KIND_ENUM_MISMATCH`。\\n| canonical_kind Quick 模式看見「能做／不能做／下一個唯一必要動作」；工程師可展開 exact source SHA、schema、受控變更清單；QA 可讀 raw evidence expectations 與 negative fixtures。無障礙模式不得依賴顏色單獨傳達 `HOLD`，機器版欄位必保留文字狀態。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-038\\\"></a>\\n## C08.2 Quick／Guided／Critical + QuestionCandidate\\nRisk = `effect × irreversibility × uncertainty × source_gap` 的**設計分類**，不是官方風險計分器。`Quick` 條件：已知 goal/kind/source、風險低、無效果授權缺口，直接產 typed proposal，不替用戶寫 repo；`Guided`：最少一個具高資訊增益的缺失，按 `information_gain` 排序只問最必要項，其餘可推進的部分正常輸出；`Critical`：涉及 Native、外部 publish、secret、不可逆或 Owner conflict 時拒絕未授權效果並引導批准。`QuestionCandidate{question_key,reason,information_gain,already_answered_source,required_owner,answer_effect,risk_class,route}`，同 `question_key+source_sha` 回答後不重問，來源變更可使問答失效並明示 why。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-r2-50cba43e49c9ca\\\"></a>\\n### C08.2A 六 Persona × 三問答密度的可實際重現 UI 路徑\\n`QuestionGate` 對同一 `subject_sha+question_key+schema_version` 只問一次；來源 SHA 變更才可重新評估，answer cache 綁 `scope,owner,source_hash,expires_at`。`information_gain` 不用任意浮點黑箱：先排除已知答案與違禁收集，再按照 `(blocks_FUO?,risk_veto?,owner_decision_required?,uncertainty_reduction?,cost)` 以決定性字典序選第一個必要問題；高風險一律升級 Critical/HITL，未知但低風險可先給無副作用預覽。\\n| persona | question_density | target_kind | JTBD_goal | user_observable_result | user_facing_copy | gate | repeat_refusal_exit |\\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- Goal+FUO；若只有藍圖而未建 wheel，使用者見 `BUILD_NOT_EXECUTED`。真 Runner 綁 Candidate SHA 安裝、JSON 增列/持久、卸載；見到 RawReceipt 才可談 User Outcome。\\n2. **Brownfield evolution**：`GJ02` 把 SBL 自身 Repo 的 failing test/scope 變成 `ScopedRepairProposal`，含 previous SHA、修補 cone、成本/退出；dirty tree 不動用戶檔。R2 未做真正施工，不拿 Markdown 說成自舉完成。\\n3. **Skill/Agent hosted example**：`GJ03-SKILL` 驗 trigger/untrigger/unload；`GJ03-AGENT` 驗 allowed/forbidden tool、stop；缺 host native receipt 顯 `HOST_UNVERIFIED`，不能互代。\\n4. **Loop A** 局部失敗→有限 patch proposal；**Loop B** local raw test/conformance；**Loop C** frozen same candidate with different principal challenge；每輪若 FAIL 產 versioned next candidate 而非改寫已接受 Oracle。正式 Owner Gate 與人類 Release 才可提升 Claim。\\n5. **SWOF cross dogfood**：在 `PREW3_SHADOW` 只接 frozen W2 readset、畫 NativeRef/Receiver expectation 與 NACK 演示，不寫 SWOF；在 `SWOF_CONNECTED` 必等待 Native ModeGate、ONE ECP、Permit、Receiver ACK/RawReceipt。若 PRE-W3 Owner 尚未給 Token，顯 `SHADOW_ONLY / NO_NATIVE_EFFECT`，不堵既有工程波次。\\n**Anti-overengineering**：若業務僅需要 Todo CLI，先交最小 local-first CLI + pytest +安全配套，不為追求完整飛輪引入 Agent OS、AI System、新 Registry、新 validator 或自造第二 Compiler。每次新增 provider/adapter 必能證明避免的重複工作/成本與可退出路徑。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-053\\\"></a>\\n# R01｜ProductIntent 與 JourneyAcceptance Typed Contracts\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-054\\\"></a>\\n## R01.1｜ProductIntent 唯一產品候選資料模型、非 的八個值**。`WORKFLOW`, `KNOWLEDGE_PACK`, `LIBRARY`, `HOST_ADAPTER`, `INTEGRATION_STACK` 須作產品的構件/TechnicalProjection，不能因全 DOC C06 的例示句變成第九 Kind。驗證器拒 `GENIE_PRODUCT`、`SKILL` 直接作 Kind；提供 id=\\\"sbl-doc01-r2-bfcc617b365003\\\"></a>\\n# R05｜Persona／JTBD／FUO 與問答流設計\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-068\\\"></a>\\n## R05.1 情境問題的資訊增益與答案去重\\n問答流程以 `known_answers`、`source_sha`、`goal`、`risk` 作 gate。若使用者說「做一個待辦 CLI」，Kind 可依 Product Owner 的合法 default 建議 CLI_TOOL，但 Repo 寫權不能從語句默許。當尚需判定「要寫哪個目錄」時，Guided 問明確、能改變 `writable_scope` 的一題；若缺自動發佈權限，Critical 先封存產品 spec，不執行 release。`QuestionCandidate` 寫 `answer_effect` 說明此問決定哪個欄位與是哪個 Gate。相同 `question_key+source_sha` 已由已上傳 Spec 回答→不能重問。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-069\\\"></a>\\n## R05.2 Accessibility／Privacy／No-fit 設計\\n新手應得到 `Quick` 短摘要加 advanced details 展開，機器版 JSON/TSV 與逐章文書仍保留；高風險 Critical 應明示被阻擋的效果和合法恢復路線，不用「我已準備好」掩蓋安全 veto。最小隱私：repo path/shas 可用，raw secret/token 不落 Source Inventory；外部網路候選只提供資訊，未批准傳送 Source code 則離線或 NO_FIT。`POS-R05` 缺路徑只問一次；`NEG-R05` 重問已知答案／Critical 被降級 Quick→`UNNECESSARY_QUESTION|RISK_ROUTE_DOWNGRADE`。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-070\\\"></a>\\n# R06｜16 個 Moments 的轉移、暫停、復原與版本漂移\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-071\\\"></a>\\n## R06.1 正向轉移示例與變體鎖\\nVariant B（§7） `M00 Understand→M01 Explore→M02 Define→M03 Specify→M04 Architect→M05 Plan→M06 Prepare→M07 Build→M08 Test→M09 Review→M10 Verify→M11 Repair→M12 Ship→M13 Maintain`，M14/15 是 Host/私人使用相容時刻；每步需 `source_variant`，不可直接同 Variant C (`M00 Intent`, `M01 Q&A`, ...)，在跨文件交接時按 `MomentCrosswalk` 解析。只有具明確 `subject_sha`/ResumeRef 的前置效力才可進行受影下一步；`NEG-R06` 未經批准將 Variant B M12 Ship 改成 Repair → MOMENT_VARIANT_CONFLICT。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-072\\\"></a>\\n## R06.2 Abort／Resume／Provider-off 與 bounded loops\\n每個 Moment 提供 `stop_reason`, `blocking_owner`, `resume_after`, `unchanged_subject_digest`；如果來源或驗收版本變，退回可重新 freeze 的來源/Spec 階段，不沿用假定舊驗證。受控效果 `retry_limit` 必由原生 ECP（P4 原生≤1且 no-backoff）和 Native Runner 持有，DOC-01 不重設。`M11` Repair 只影響 FirstFail cone，需新 Candidate SHA，不覆蓋既有 Evidence；`M14/M15` 任一 Host/產品不支持時逐個標 `HOST_UNSUPPORTED`，不以其他平台成功遮蔽。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-073\\\"></a>\\n# R07｜三條 Golden Journey 的實測設計與退出\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-074\\\"></a>\\n## R07.1 Product-level feature acceptance，非 mock 通過\\nGJ01 的 `sbl-todo --json list`、GJ02 的 `git rev-parse HEAD`、GJ03 的 Host effective load 都是**下一階工程可直接執行的期待**；真相留在 receipt。Mock 可用於 `design test`，不能滿足 `RawReceipt` 或 end-user `FUO`。必要環境欄 `sandbox_id,OS,host_version,repo_root,subject_sha,allowed_effect,runner/checker_id,test_time,exit_code,stdout_digest,negative_log,uninstall_readback`，未有即 NOT_EXECUTED。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-075\\\"></a>\\n## R07.2 Journey negative evidence 與 rollback 歸屬\\nGJ01 path traversal 需既有測資加 `symlink outside root`，拒絕且無 outside side effect；GJ02 stale HEAD、offscope writes 各需 raw 寫在同一欄。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-076\\\"></a>\\n# R08｜Reuse-first、六 Donor、NOBJ-001～024 保護槽位與熱插拔\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-077\\\"></a>\\n## R08.1 六個具名 Donor 的產品用途與合法進入條件\\n能力選型原則是 版本化接口（F14）\\n七類與 SBL 8 ProductKinds 不同域。`SevenKindReaderProjection` Proposal 必有 `source_namespace=\\\"SWOF_PRIMARY_KIND\\\"`, `kind_enum`, `native_entity_ref`, `native_owner`, `source_version`, `source_digest`, `relation_refs[]`, `consumer=\\\"SBL_DOC11\\\"`, `fit_policy`, `mode_gate_ref`, `expiry`, `adapter_version`；缺任何正式 SWOF Kind schema/231 Entity/59 Relation resolution 時只能 `BINDER_HOLD`，不補寫其完整真相。\\n| SWOF Kind | DOC05 Reader port | SBL 8 Kind fit / no-fit | Producer / consumer | 專屬 NEG |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| `PRODUCT` | `ProductNativeRef→ProductBindingRef` | 可做 CLI_TOOL/AGENT_SKILL/SIMPLE_AGENT 主產品，但需被 DOC02 判定 | SWOF Product Owner→DOC11 | PRODUCT 被當 ARTIFACT → `PRIMARY_KIND_COLLISION` |\\n| `CAPABILITY` | `CapabilityNativeRef→CapabilityUseRef` | 只能能力 slot，不能自行 mint ProductKind | SWOF Capability Owner→DOC11 | 當 PRODUCT → `KIND_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH` |\\n| `ARTIFACT` | `ArtifactNativeRef→ArtifactDeliveryRef` | `GENIE.md` 是產物格式，不等同 SBL `GENIE/GENIE.md` Runtime Writer | SWOF Artifact Owner→DOC11 | 同名 GENIE 違規自寫 → `PRIMARY_KIND_COLLISION` |\\n| `COMPOSITION` | `CompositionNativeRef→CompositionEdgeRef` | 多技能組合需 ComponentManifest，不能變成第二 Agent OS | SWOF Composition Owner→DOC11 | 缺 edge 權威 → `RELATION_REF_MISSING` |\\n| `LIFECYCLE` | `LifecycleNativeRef→PhaseBindingRef` | 狀態交接僅借原生狀態，不等同 ModeGate | SWOF Lifecycle Owner→DOC11 | 將版本 W4 當 MODE → `STATE_NAMESPACE_COLLISION` |\\n| `PLATFORM` | `PlatformNativeRef→HostCompatibilityRef` | PLUGIN/PROFILE 需 Host 被資格化；不等同 Host Effect Permit | SWOF Platform Owner→DOC11 | 未驗平台自稱可寫 → `HOST_GATE_INCOMPLETE` |\\n| `RUNTIME_UNIT` | `RuntimeUnitNativeRef→RuntimeObservationRef` | 僅原生 Runtime identity，SBL v0.1 AGENT_OS/AI_SYSTEM 不自批准 | SWOF Runtime Owner→DOC11 | 用 proposal 冒充 RawReceipt → `NATIVE_RUNTIME_UNVERIFIED` |\\n每 Kind 均含 `FX-D05-SWOF-<KIND>-POS`：原生 Resolver 存在且同版時可形成 READ_ONLY_CANDIDATE；`-NEG`：變更唯一 namespace/kind 後必拒收；`-SEC`：Native EntityRef 無授權時 NoEffect。`231` 與 `59` 是上位 SWOF 的 corpus 索引維度，不是本冊已對 231/59 完成現場 Resolver 的證明。\\n### R06.3.A｜SWOF Native 接入與 NoEffect 證明：原版反證與核心設計保留\\n**本域反證入口**：SWOF 連接器沒有 Native ACK。**輸入／判準**：ReadProjection 不是許可，保留 NO_NATIVE_EFFECT。資料責任維持本節所指定的正式 Owner；此處的 `expected` 是設計 Oracle，不是已執行的 RawReceipt。\\nSBL 輸出 `PDReadProjection/ECPRequirementEnvelope`→DOC-11 Adapter→SWOF Native WorkOrder/Receiver 由原生 Writer 核准→HGK Permit/Effect/Readback。`NoEffectProof{subject_sha,mode,scope,prohibited_effects,receiver_ack_ref:null,observed_world_effects:0,evidence_ref}` 是預期資料形狀，不是現場 zero-effect receipt。Shadow `edge_id,producer,consumer,source_ref,source_digest,subject_sha,schema_id,schema_semver,wire_version,sequence,nonce,expiry,workorder_namespace,workorder_ref,mode_gate_ref,permit_ref,ecp_ref,readback_ref,rollback_ref,ack_status,first_fail,owner,tt_open[]`，**`expiry` 必 ISO 8601 future date-time，不能用 `UNSET_BY_NATIVE_OWNER` 當日期**。`ack_status∈{PROPOSAL_ACK,PROPOSAL_NACK,HOLD}`；Native `ADMIT` 禁填此欄。Order：decode → exact schema → unknown-key reject → signature/owner policy → same subject/scope → timestamp TTL → monotone `sequence` → stage ABI version → Native admission/permission → world readback。任何 step 失敗輸出 `NACK{edge_id,first_fail,missing_fields,subject_sha,ttl_action:NO_REPLAY,readback_required,owner}`，終止。`PROPOSAL_ACK` 不代表 Native effective admission。\\n重試行為：READ_ONLY metadata query 可在新快照下重做；對 Governed Effect 的 `unknown` 僅做 `read-world`, 不自動重放；若 Native Receipt 不在，保持 `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME`，須 Native Owner 審閱或補償。`TTL_INVALID`、`ABI_UNVERIFIED`、`HANDOFF_STAGE_MISROUTE`、`WORKORDER_NAMESPACE_COLLISION`、`EFFECT_KEY_STAGE_COLLISION` 均 NoEffect。對 D05→D11、D11→SWOF W3、W3→W4、W4→W5、W5→HGK，各給一個 `FX-D05-HANDOFF-<EDGE>-POS/NEG` 的版本限制預期；SWOF Native W3/W4/W5 因 stage version 尚未核，POS 只會回 `HOLD`（不是成功 Native ACK）。\\n每條 `TypedHandoff@1` 必含 `source_ref,source_digest,subject_hash,producer,consumer,schema_id,version,workorder_ref,pi_ref,pd_read_ref,ecp_requirement_ref,chosen_native_ecp_ref,permission_ref,gate_ref,ack_nack_predicate,first_fail,raw_receipt_ref,expiry,rollback_ref,tt_open`，精確區分 `schema_id=SBL_PROPOSAL_*` 與正式接收端 ABI。`ACK` 要求 Parser 以原生 schema 檢驗、subject SHA 對等、Producer Owner 有權、TTL/Freshness、反放行的 Negative tests 皆符合；任何一點不符 `NACK` 並保留原受審 SHA。歷史候選將 W3/W4/W5 映射為 readiness/executor/evidence，與另一版本的 route/review/receiver 相矛盾；本 r4 只採 **SWOF_STAGE_ABI_HOLD + StageSemanticBinding.version_range=UNRESOLVED**，不得按任一候選含義解讀現行 ABI。Receiver 僅可由 SWOF/HGK Owner 正式核准 ABI 後執行，`ABI_UNVERIFIED` 不可預設欄位存在。\\n**Zero-Rediscovery** 代表下一位 Reader 從 HandoffLedger 直接取 `source_digest, exact subject SHA, typed schema, first_fail, TT, raw receipt locator, expiry, rollback_ref`；不能只收到「已完成」摘要而再猜版本。UNKNOWN_OUTCOME 回復一定先讀世界，再由 Owner 核准新 Permit 或補償；禁止自行 replay。\\n# R11｜外部研究、取代／衝突／TT、品質門檻與單一 MD Readback\\n## R11.1 2026 外部雷達：來源事實與准入結論\\n### R11.1.A｜外部版本差分直接落入受影 不可無聲減法\\n`U03` 是 **3 SP × 3 使用動作**的候選笛卡兒展開（安裝/有效載入/真調用），額外 nine operational test cells 不替換 149 上位 ID；每 Host （若原生來源要求四宿主）還有各自 install/load/trigger/uninstall 的受影乘積，**Host 名單及 Owner scope 待 DOC-10/Native 核定**。`U14` 要分 DEV ECP、OPS ECP 及 ONE ECP 原生映射，不能宣稱三者是三個平行執行授權；`U20` 要 RepoContext、WorkOrder、ONE ECP、ExecutionBinding 四個獨立簽核點；`U27` 把 source SHA 與 evidence SHA 分清；`U35` 有 Loop A/B/C 各不同 所代表的範圍仍不夠細時，新增 **proposal** `Uxx.ext*` 並記 `EXPANSION_NOT_CANONICAL`，由 source owner ratify，禁止暗算已閉合。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-026\\\"></a>\\n### C05.3.1 來源 child 與建議擴展的雙 Ledger\\n原始 149 筆永久保留 `source-native child ID`；建議增加的 `Uxx.ext` 放 `proposal_child_ledger`，在沒有上位 Owner ratification 時不寫回 149 上位分母。查詢可同時回傳兩個 ledger，但審計器必須分欄統計 `source_native_count=149` 與 `proposal_extension_count`。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-027\\\"></a>\\n### C05.3A｜完整子義務的分母分離與跨域拒收\\n`149` 是上位 native child SourceIDs 的**來源身份分母**；`50` 是 parent 分母；細粒度規範原子分母必須額外計算，而且在來源 fragment 截斷時不可自宣已達到 149 個 owner-ratified atoms。U14/U20/U27/U35/U42/U50 及 U03 展開的 `SBL-PROP-U*.ext` 是候選 extension，只允許出現在獨立 Proposal ledger，不得覆寫原始 child ID、來源 sha、Oracle 作者或 acceptance 真值。任一 parent 中含「同時、除非、任一、全部」須拆成不同作用域/否定條件/Owner；對未見原文的原子寫 `BLOCKED_TT`，提供被要求的原始片段 locator 及 Owner 行動，而非補出看似完整的引言。\\n**C05 逐原子判準**：`source_clause → atom → product_spec → acc → POS_fixture & NEG_fixture → EExp → DELIVER → consumer` 每條邊須能在同版本、同 source hash 連結；任一缺失只降低當條成熟度，不把所有有 ID 的原子統計為語義 Closed。DOC-01 可定 `AcceptanceCue`，`CR-ORACLE-001` 未解前不可替 PIPD DOC-07 寫正式 Oracle。\\n## C05.4 Applicability／正負反證與 C05 SPEC\\n每個子原子套用 `ProductKind × Mode × Host × UserRisk × Permission` 的適用性判定，不能把 `Unknown` 寫成 N/A；跨 DOC `owner_doc` 永遠以原生 Writer 優先。由 DOC-01 使用者角度測 `ExpectedExperience`，由 DOC-03/08 等原生負責正式 PI 與 Oracle：`positive=合法欄位+同候選 hash+正確 viewer`, `negative=missing child/wrong consumer/foreign SHA`, `edge=不適用僅有 Owner 明示理由`, `security=unauthorized SideEffect must deny/no residue`。\\n`input_schema=SourceParent+SourceChild+Mode+Kind; output_schema=RequirementAtomLedger+ApplicabilityRef; preconditions=50 parent and 149 authoritative child IDs resolvable; error=COMPOUND_ATOM_MISSING; first_fail=SOURCE_MISSING→COMPOUND_ATOM_MISSING; owner=SBL-R009 (editorial), SBL Product Owner (product), individual canonical owner (writer); consumer=DOC-03/08/09; positive_fixture=POS-C05 all IDs distinct and typed; negative_fixture=NEG-C05 U20.WorkOrder absent; rollback_or_no_effect=no effect`。正式 closure 須獨立 Reviewer 核對來源片段與本表；本輪不宣稱已完成 semantics-level exhaustive audit。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-028\\\"></a>\\n# C06｜SBL 八個 ProductKinds C08.2 Quick／Guided／Critical + QuestionCandidate\\nRisk = `effect × irreversibility × uncertainty × source_gap` 的**設計分類**，不是官方風險計分器。`Quick` 條件：已知 goal/kind/source、風險低、無效果授權缺口，直接產 typed proposal，不替用戶寫 repo；`Guided`：最少一個具高資訊增益的缺失，按 `information_gain` 排序只問最必要項，其餘可推進的部分正常輸出；`Critical`：涉及 Native、外部 publish、secret、不可逆或 Owner conflict `scope,owner,source_hash,expires_at`。`information_gain` 不用任意浮點黑箱：先排除已知答案與違禁收集，再按照 `(blocks_FUO?,risk_veto?,owner_decision_required?,uncertainty_reduction?,cost)` 以決定性字典序選第一個必要問題；高風險一律升級 gate。若使用者說「做一個待辦 CLI」，Kind 可依 Product Owner 的合法 default 建議 CLI_TOOL，但 Repo 寫權不能從語句默許。當尚需判定「要寫哪個目錄」時，Guided 問明確、能改變 `writable_scope` 的一題；若缺自動發佈權限，Critical 先封存產品 spec，不執行 release。`QuestionCandidate` 寫 `answer_effect` 說明此問決定哪個欄位與是哪個 Gate。相同 `question_key+source_sha` 已由已上傳 Spec 回答→不能重問。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-069\\\"></a>\\n## R05.2 Accessibility／Privacy／No-fit 設計\\n新手應得到 `Quick` 短摘要加 advanced details 展開，機器版 JSON/TSV 與逐章文書仍保留；高風險 Critical 應明示被阻擋的效果和合法恢復路線，不用「我已準備好」掩蓋安全 veto。最小隱私：repo path/shas 可用，raw secret/token 不落 Source Inventory；外部網路候選只提供資訊，未批准傳送 Source code 則離線或 NO_FIT。`POS-R05` 缺路徑只問一次；`NEG-R05` 重問已知答案／Critical 被降級 Quick→`UNNECESSARY_QUESTION|RISK_ROUTE_DOWNGRADE`。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-070\\\"></a>\\n# R06｜16 個 Moments 的轉移、暫停、復原與版本漂移\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-071\\\"></a>\\n## R06.1 正向轉移示例與變體鎖\\nVariant B（§7） `M00 Understand→M01 Explore→M02 Define→M03 Specify→M04 Architect→M05 Plan→M06 Prepare→M07 Build→M08 Test→M09 Review→M10 Verify→M11 Repair→M12 Ship→M13 Maintain`，M14/15 是 Host/私人使用相容時刻；每步需 `source_variant`，不可直接同 Variant C (`M00 Intent`, `M01 Q&A`, ...)，在跨文件交接時按 `MomentCrosswalk` 解析。只有具明確 `subject_sha`/ResumeRef 的前置效力才可進行受影下一步；`NEG-R06` 未經批准將 Variant B M12 Ship 改成 Repair → MOMENT_VARIANT_CONFLICT。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-072\\\"></a>\\n## R06.2 Abort／Resume／Provider-off 與 bounded loops\\n每個 Moment 提供 `stop_reason`, `blocking_owner`, `resume_after`, `unchanged_subject_digest`；如果來源或驗收版本變，退回可重新 freeze 的來源/Spec 階段，不沿用假定舊驗證。受控效果 `retry_limit` 必由原生 ECP（P4 原生≤1且 no-backoff）和 Native Runner 持有，DOC-01 不重設。`M11` Repair 只影響 FirstFail cone，需新 Candidate SHA，不覆蓋既有 Evidence；`M14/M15` 任一 Host/產品不支持時逐個標 `HOST_UNSUPPORTED`，不以其他平台成功遮蔽。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-073\\\"></a>\\n# R07｜三條 Golden Journey 的實測設計與退出\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-074\\\"></a>\\n## R07.1 Product-level feature acceptance，非 mock 通過\\nGJ01 的 `sbl-todo --json list`、GJ02 的 `git rev-parse HEAD`、GJ03 的 Host effective load 都是**下一階工程可直接執行的期待**；真相留在 receipt。Mock 可用於 `design test`，不能滿足 `RawReceipt` 或 end-user `FUO`。必要環境欄 `sandbox_id,OS,host_version,repo_root,subject_sha,allowed_effect,runner/checker_id,test_time,exit_code,stdout_digest,negative_log,uninstall_readback`，未有即 NOT_EXECUTED。\\n<a id=\\\"sbl-doc01-sec-075\\\"></a>\\n## R07.2 Journey negative evidence 與 rollback 歸屬\\nGJ01 path traversal 需既有測資加 `symlink outside root`，拒絕且無 outside side effect；GJ02 stale HEAD、offscope writes 各需 raw git diff + permission deny；GJ03 nontrigger + forbidden tool denial + uninstall re-discovery negative。Effect rollback 歸 Native/Repo Owner，DOC-01 只規劃退出需求。接受者不得把沒有被執行的 `expected` 與已觀測 `actual` 同意才可交正式 Writer。\\n- **Native Effect**：HGK/Fabric 受控外部/Repo 世界效果；本輪零效果。\\n- **Maker/Checker**：需獨立身份與 raw receipt，單一作者分角色思考不等於獨立驗收。\\n- **Primary Doc**：上位唯一章節 R05｜DEV／OPS Effect Lanes、ONE ECP 選擇與 Permission SoD\\n## R05.1 選擇器、排他性與變更授權\\n### R05.1.A｜跨 lane ONE ECP 選擇原子：原版反證與核心設計保留\\n**本域反證入口**：兩份同時有效 chosen_ecp_id。**輸入／判準**：同 effect 數量大於一→ECP_WRITER_CONFLICT。資料責任維持本節所指定的正式 Owner；此處的 `expected` 是設計 Oracle，不是已執行的 RawReceipt。\\nR05 僅定義跨 Lane selector，不重寫 C28 原子不變量。`ECPSelectionDecision{effect_id,mode,lane,eligible_writer,eligible_receiver,chosen_ecp_id,stage_scope,so_d_rule,approval_ref,expiry,conflict_state}`。若兩個 `chosen_ecp_id` 對同一 effect 同時有效，`ECP_WRITER_CONFLICT` 立即 NACK；不選擇「最後更新者」。**POS** 同 effect 唯一有效 ECP；**NEG** 同時選 DEV 與 OPS permit→`ECP_WRITER_CONFLICT`。\\n### R05.1.B｜歷史 r2 實質協議：跨 lane ONE ECP 選擇原子\\n**原意／機制**：每個 effect_id+stage_id 在受保護 native gate 下至多一個 eligible chosen ECP；多階段合法時每階一個不同 effect record。**Typed I/O**：`StageEffectSet → ECPSelectionDecision`。**消費路由**：`SBL DOC05 → 原生 PIPD DOC-05／對應 SBL 下游`；製作此文字者不自動是原生 Writer。\\n**定向 NEG（單欄破壞）**：同階雙 ECP 同時 active→ECP_WRITER_CONFLICT。**本地失敗邊界**：原生 effect 必保留獨立授權與 world readback，不得從設計 fixture 推斷已執行。\\n**本節逐原子閉環**：`D05-REQ-R05-1 → SBL-D05-SPEC-R05-1 → ACC-D05-R05-1 → FX-D05-R05-1-POS/NEG → EEXP-D05-R05-1 → DEL-D05-R05-1`。原始 r1 clause=`SBL_PIPD-LS-PKG_DOC-05_%E8%97%8D%E5%9C%96+skeleton_2026-10-18_r1(1).md#L734`，r1 SHA256=`aea120809b40794849449196bba27e01bc795466a64a73c45f5f82da87b40d13`；原生欄位如受影應交 `PIPD_LS_DOC-05` 的有效 Schema/Owner 審核，真實 Native receipt **未取得**。\\n**唯一 Writer+多階合法分解**：`unique(effect_instance=(subject,effect_class,target,lane,stage))`，每筆 effect_instance 至多一個 `chosen_ecp_id` 和 Native Writer。多階合法建成 `parent_workflow_id + stage_no`，每階須原生核准自己的 ECP/permit/readback，禁止把兩個 stage 合併成單一萬用 ECP。`Failover` 只能由原生 Owner 停用原有效 key→確認 UNKNOWN outcome 無執行→簽發新的批准，不能讓兩個 Receiver 競跑同一作用。`NEG-ONEECP-DUAL` 模擬同鍵雙有效 ECP → `ECP_WRITER_CONFLICT`。\\n## R05.2 人員、權杖、審計軌跡分離\\n### R05.2.A｜Actor、Issuer、Checker、Receiver 五方分權：原版反證與核心設計保留\\n**本域反證入口**：issuer 撤銷 Token 後仍作 deploy。**輸入／判準**：token revocation 命中→PERMISSION_TOKEN_REVOKED，不調用 Receiver。資料責任維持本節所指定的正式 Owner；此處的 `expected` 是設計 Oracle，不是已執行的 RawReceipt。\\n`maker` 設計/執行提案、`checker` 獨立檢驗、`acceptor` Gate 判定、`issuer` 發 Token、`receiver` Native 效果執行。不可使用同一 Principal 假分身、多 Agent Persona 假檢查。Token 只留 `{issuer,key_id,expiry,revocation_locator,scope_hash}`；絕不放 token 原文到 LEDGER。`PERMISSION_TOKEN_MISSING/EXPIRED/REVOKED` 分別 FIRSTFAIL；日志須遮蔽 secret，`EEXP-D05-SOD-01` 預期 token 驗證 raw ACK/NACK。\\n### R05.2.B｜歷史 r2 實質協議：Actor、Issuer、Checker、Receiver 五方分權\\n**原意／機制**：權限 token 存引用/expiry/revocation 指標，不輸出 secret；同一人身兼不允許 SoD 欄由 Native 判斷。**Typed I/O**：`ActorBinding+PermitRef → PermissionProjection`。**消費路由**：`SBL DOC05 → 原生 PIPD DOC-05／對應 SBL 下游`；製作此文字者不自動是原生 Writer。\\n**定向 NEG（單欄破壞）**：撤銷 token 仍 dispatch→PERMISSION_TOKEN_REVOKED。**本地失敗邊界**：原生 effect 必保留獨立授權與 world readback，不得從設計 fixture 推斷已執行。\\n**本節逐原子閉環**：`D05-REQ-R05-2 → SBL-D05-SPEC-R05-2 → ACC-D05-R05-2 → FX-D05-R05-2-POS/NEG → EEXP-D05-R05-2 → DEL-D05-R05-2`。原始 r1 clause=`SBL_PIPD-LS-PKG_DOC-05_%E8%97%8D%E5%9C%96+skeleton_2026-10-18_r1(1).md#L742`，r1 SHA256=`aea120809b40794849449196bba27e01bc795466a64a73c45f5f82da87b40d13`；原生欄位如受影應交 `PIPD_LS_DOC-05` 的有效 Schema/Owner 審核，真實 Native receipt **未取得**。\\n## R05.3 Effect 決策案例\\n### R05.3.A｜Effect 舞台雙階示範與崩潰競態：原版反證與核心設計保留\\n**本域反證入口**：DEV build 成功便請求 OPS 發布。**輸入／判準**：無 OPS WorkOrder/Permit，不可隱式自動轉場。資料責任維持本節所指定的正式 Owner；此處的 `expected` 是設計 Oracle，不是已執行的 RawReceipt。\\n**案例**：同一 WorkOrder 的 `src/adapter.ts` 更動（DEV）與生產部署（OPS）是兩個 effect，不可以用 DEV 一張 ECP 直接授權部署；若 Native Owner 定義工作流「先 DEV 後 OPS」，兩個 scope、token、readback、rollback 及具可驗證交接 gate。Shadow 模式永遠 `NO_NATIVE_EFFECT`。`DEL-D05-ECP-SELECTION` 為選擇矩陣，SBL 只讀。\\n### R05.3.B｜歷史 r2 實質協議：Effect 舞台雙階示範與崩潰競態\\n**原意／機制**：以 DEV code patch 和 OPS deploy 作兩個 effect，每個持不同 permit、commit/readback、補償；丟 ACK 不重試。**Typed I/O**：`DEVStage+OPSStage → StagePlan[]`。**消費路由**：`SBL DOC05 → 原生 PIPD DOC-05／對應 SBL 下游`；製作此文字者不自動是原生 Writer。\\n**定向 NEG（單欄破壞）**：DEV 成功便自動 OPS 發布→ECP_PERMISSION。**本地失敗邊界**：原生 effect 必保留獨立授權與 world readback，不得從設計 fixture 推斷已執行。\\n**本節逐原子閉環**：`D05-REQ-R05-3 → SBL-D05-SPEC-R05-3 → ACC-D05-R05-3 → FX-D05-R05-3-POS/NEG → EEXP-D05-R05-3 → DEL-D05-R05-3`。原始 r1 clause=`SBL_PIPD-LS-PKG_DOC-05_%E8%97%8D%E5%9C%96+skeleton_2026-10-18_r1(1).md#L750`，r1 SHA256=`aea120809b40794849449196bba27e01bc795466a64a73c45f5f82da87b40d13`；原生欄位如受影應交 `PIPD_LS_DOC-05` 的有效 Schema/Owner 審核，真實 Native receipt **未取得**。\\n## R05.4｜DEV／OPS 權限與零效果檢查表\\n`DEV` 可提 code/test/diff/worktree 更動，但只在 Repo Owner 受界且 Native Permit 有效時；`OPS` 涉 migration/deploy/backup/restore/rollback，必有不同權限類別、不同操作憑證與額外 rollback authorization。受控 executor、Maker、checker、permit issuer、receiver 均保留獨立 principal ID 及 audit event；同一模型扮演各視角**不**構成 SoD。`STANDALONE` 可出讀取與設計工件；`PREW3_SHADOW` 僅影子對照無效果；`SWOF_CONNECTED` 只有 SWOF/HGK 原生 Gate、ACK、Token 全通過後才可能 effect。**POS** 合法分權的 `DEV` 修改提案；**NEG** 用 DEV Token 做 OPS deploy→`OPS_PERMISSION_REQUIRED`；**EDGE** 責任者撤銷 token→`PERMIT_REVOKED`，停止 effect。Evidence=權限映射／撤銷原物、Native ACK，不是提示語言。\\n# R06｜三模式／Eight ProductKinds／SWOF 對接之 Applicability + No-Effect\\n## R06.1 ModeGate 與產品類型的獨立交集\\n### R06.1.A｜Kind 狀態和 Host 授權雙重相交：原版反證與核心設計保留\\n**本域反證**：將 `PLUGIN`（DEFERRED_UNVERIFIED）冒充 CLI v0.1 supported 時，回 `PRODUCT_KIND_NOT_ADMITTED`；Source 為上位 SBL v2.0r1 L864–875、L896–905，而非外部工具版本新聞。原類別精確名稱已由上位設計源驗明，但該類在當輪 Native Host/Mode 是否 eligible，仍須 DOC-01 與 DOC-11 交集決定。\\n**八個精確 ProductKind 與目標 status**：`CLI_TOOL`, `AGENT_SKILL`, `SIMPLE_AGENT` 為 `IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET`；`PLUGIN`, `PROFILE` 為 `DEFERRED_UNVERIFIED`；`AGENT_OS`, `AI_SYSTEM` 為 `UNSUPPORTED_V0_1`；`GENIE/GENIE.md` 為 `SWOF_RESERVED_COMPATIBILITY_ONLY`。SBL 產品種類和 SWOF 七個 Primary Kinds 分屬不同 namespace，不能把 `CLI_TOOL` 寫成 SWOF entity type。`mode∈{STANDALONE,PREW3_SHADOW,SWOF_CONNECTED}` 為運作模式，不直接賦權。MVP 實作目標 != 當輪 Host/Release 已合格。\\n**個別情境**：STANDALONE 只能對真宿主明確允許的本地效果請求准入；PREW3_SHADOW 零 Native effect；SWOF_CONNECTED 需真 WorkOrder、ONE ECP、Permit、Receiver ACK。關閉本章的條件不是三行模式標題，而是每個 `(ProductKind,Mode,Effect)` 有 Owner/適用性決策、POS/NEG、適用 SourceTrace。原生 Gate 不可用時標 `MODEGATE_ELIGIBILITY_HOLD`；非 v0.1 ProductKind So the loop terminates not because\\r\\nthe work is finished but because the *only available move* is to report.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis is a system defect, and it has three components:\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **No executable queue.** Status registers, TT registers and the kanban board all answer \\\"where are we\\\"; none answers\\r\\n   \\\"what do I run next, with which command, and what proves it worked\\\".\\r\\n2. **Blocked reads as stopped.** 12 of 18 cards were blocked with `initial_status`, a state that carries no reason and\\r\\n   no next action — so a reader cannot distinguish \\\"waiting on an owner\\\" from \\\"not started\\\".\\r\\n3. **No retry ladder.** The first EXECUTE dispatch died at 300 s and the round reported instead of re-scoping the task.\\r\\n   The same task later succeeded in 344 s once re-scoped; the failure was survivable and was treated as terminal.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Repair, chosen for leverage\\r\\n\\r\\n**A queue whose items are commands, plus a driver that parks blockers and keeps going.**\\r\\n\\r\\n- `QUEUE_R15_2.json`: every item carries `id`, `status`, `owner_class` (`AGENT` / `OWNER` / `HOST`), `next_action`,\\r\\n  and for agent items a literal `resume_cmd` with a `expect` condition.\\r\\n- `tools/advance_queue.py`: runs ready `AGENT` items one at a time, records the observed output, marks `DONE` on the\\r\\n  expectation, and on failure **parks** the item with a typed reason and continues to the next one.\\r\\n- Stop policy, now explicit and the only legal stops: destructive action, missing credential, mandated lane\\r\\n  unavailable, or an owner-only decision. Everything else parks and the driver continues.\\r\\n\\r\\nDesign note: the driver deliberately does not try to be a scheduler. It is a resume pointer with a retry ladder; the\\r\\nstate it needs is a file, so it survives context compression, a new session, and a reboot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Why this is better than \\\"try harder\\\"\\r\\n\\r\\nA resolve-to-continue instruction fails exactly when context is compressed, which is when the work is longest. A queue\\r\\nfile plus a driver moves the memory from the conversation into the repository, so \\\"continue\\\" becomes a command rather\\r\\nthan a recollection. It is also auditable: the queue records what ran, what it printed, and what was parked.\\r\\n--- FAR_ROOT_CAUSE_AUTHORITY.md\\r\\n# FAR: root cause of \\\"still blocked\\\" after repeated FAR\\r\\n\\r\\n## 0. The question, split correctly\\r\\n\\r\\nTwo different phenomena were being called by one name:\\r\\n\\r\\n- **stopping** — the round ends while agent-actionable work remains;\\r\\n- **not completing** — the round reaches items that no agent may satisfy.\\r\\n\\r\\nThe first was fixed (queue, lease, guard, scheduler). The second kept recurring after every FAR, because every FAR was\\r\\naimed at the first. That misdirection *is* the root cause, and it is not a model problem.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Attribution, with evidence from this round\\r\\n\\r\\n| layer | contribution | measurement | verdict |\\r\\n|---|---|---|---|\\r\\n| **Hermes (runtime)** | the loop was conversation-pulled; no scheduler by default | 12 stops, each after a push; `cron` job count = 0 before this round | **real cause, fixed** (lease + guard + `12eff9cba53c`) |\\r\\n| **model / session** | context compaction destroys in-flight intent | 12 compactions; state re-derived from prose each time | **amplifier, fixed** (state in files + resume cmds) |\\r\\n| **SBL** | no front door that refuses a round's closure | queue exhaustion was indistinguishable from completion until `continuation_guard.py` | **real cause, fixed in round tree; control-plane half is candidate only** |\\r\\n| **HG-KSEOS** | states named above their predicates (`DELIVERY_READY`) | `lifecycle.py:172` guards `DELIVERED` but not `DELIVERY_READY` | **real cause, candidate fix, not applied** |\\r\\n| **Fabric** | defines principals, not effort: W3 needs a Domain Owner admission; release needs a seal | `SWOF_CONNECTED -> BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`; `release: BLOCKED` | **dominant cause of \\\"not completing\\\"; not a defect** |\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. The actual root cause\\r\\n\\r\\n**The user's standing authorization and the governance contract quantify over different things.**\\r\\n\\r\\n- The authorization is about **effort and continuity**: \\\"do not stop, use FAR, execute your recommendations\\\".\\r\\n- The Fabric/HGK predicates are about **principal identity**: \\\"only a Domain Owner may admit W3\\\", \\\"only an AO may\\r\\n  accept\\\", \\\"only an owner may seal a release\\\".\\r\\n\\r\\nAn agent can satisfy the first instruction by working indefinitely. It cannot satisfy the second by working at all,\\r\\nbecause the predicate is `signed_by ∈ {owner}` — a set that no amount of computation enlarges. When both arrive in the\\r\\nsame turn, every possible action violates one of them:\\r\\n\\r\\n- stop → violates the continuity instruction;\\r\\n- sign anyway → violates the governance contract (and is the one failure that cannot be repaired later, because a\\r\\n  forged admission is indistinguishable from a real one downstream).\\r\\n\\r\\n**So the round did not stop because the model was lazy or the harness was missing a scheduler. It stopped because I kept\\r\\nchoosing the only legal action — refuse to forge — and then dressed that refusal as an ending instead of issuing the\\r\\nrequest that would have unblocked it.** The missing component was never compute; it was a **principal request**: a\\r\\nfirst-class, tracked, one-click-shaped ask addressed to the entity that can actually satisfy the predicate.\\r\\n\\r\\nThat is why repeated FAR failed: each FAR treated \\\"blocked on an owner\\\" as a symptom to be engineered around, when it is\\r\\na *fact about authority* that has to be **issued**, not solved.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 3. Why the repair is not \\\"get more authorization\\\"\\r\\n\\r\\nThe user has already granted everything a user can grant. Granting it again changes nothing, because the predicate is\\r\\nnot `authorized_by_user` — it is `signed_by_domain_owner`. A user who is not that owner cannot make it true by fiat, and\\r\\nan agent that pretends otherwise produces the one artefact class the whole contract exists to prevent. **The correct\\r\\nengineering response to an unsatisfiable-by-agent predicate is to make it satisfiable-by-owner in one step, and to\\r\\nprove the step was taken.**\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. The engineering solution (three components, all mechanical)\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1 Satisfiability classification, declared per item\\r\\n\\r\\nEvery denominator item carries `satisfiable_by ∈ {AGENT, OWNER, HOST, EXTERNAL_AO}` **and** the field that makes it so\\r\\n(e.g. `required_signature: \\\"domain_owner\\\"`, `required_artifact: \\\"host_id\\\"`). Without this, the same item gets\\r\\nre-litigated every round: it looks like unfinished work, so the next agent tries again, fails again, reports again.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2 Principal requests as artefacts\\r\\n\\r\\n`PRINCIPAL_REQUESTS/<item>.md` — one per owner-gated item, containing: the exact predicate, the artifact already built\\r\\nand waiting, the **literal** action or command that satisfies it, what it unblocks, an expiry, and the fallback if\\r\\ndenied. This converts \\\"not in my scope\\\" into \\\"issued, tracked, one step from unblocked\\\". It is the difference between a\\r\\nblocked round and a **pending decision with a form attached**.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3 A guard that refuses both false endings\\r\\n\\r\\nThe continuation guard already refuses \\\"done\\\" while agent work remains. It must equally refuse **\\\"blocked\\\" without a\\r\\nformal request**: an item parked with no principal request is indistinguishable from an item abandoned, and abandonment\\r\\nis what a chat turn looks like from the outside. New blocker: `UNISSUED_PRINCIPAL_REQUEST`. Together the two refusals\\r\\nleave exactly one honest terminal state: *no agent work remains, and every remaining item is an issued request awaiting\\r\\na named principal.*\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. What this predicts, and how it would be falsified\\r\\n\\r\\nIf the analysis is right, then after this repair the round should be able to sit indefinitely without a chat turn,\\r\\nwith every open item addressable by a single owner action, and no further FAR should find a new \\\"why did it stop\\\"\\r\\ncause. It is falsified if the guard's next refusals are again about agent-actionable work — that would mean the queue\\r\\nwas under-filled, not that authority was the limit.\\r\\n--- FAR_DECISIONS_R15_2.md\\r\\n# FAR decisions for the five parked queue items\\r\\n\\r\\nEvery parked item has an owner class, a recommendation, the exact one-line action the owner can take, and what the\\r\\nagent will do the moment that action lands. Nothing here is signed by the agent.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W02 — Fabric active policy disposition (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** The round consumes Fabric as `FABRIC_CURRENT_ACTIVE_VIA_HGK_CONSUMER`, but no artefact names *which*\\r\\npolicy version is active, and `TT-R15.2-FRONTDOOR-SANCTIONED-DRIFT` shows the front door disagreeing with the declaring\\r\\nconfig (`10100` hard-codes `deepseek-v4.1-flash`; `config/hermes-codex-lane.json` declares `minimax-m3.1-flash-free`).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** Two configs claim authority over the same decision, and neither is marked active. The disagreement is\\r\\nstructural, not a typo: a front door with a hard-coded model cannot follow a config that is meant to change.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation (cheapest correct fix).** Declare the active policy digest in one place (`config/active-policy.json`\\r\\nwith `policy_digest`, `declared_by`, `declared_at`) and make the front door *read* it instead of hard-coding a model.\\r\\nUntil that exists, the sanctioned drift is the honest state.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action (one line).** Name the active policy digest, or authorise the agent to treat `hermes-codex-lane.json` as\\r\\nactive and retire the hard-coded front door.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Bind the digest, re-run doctor, and re-measure the front door's declared-vs-served model.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W12 — SWOF W3 admission (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `SWOF_CONNECTED` exists in `MODES` with disposition `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`; `E08`/`E09` (first real SWOF) are\\r\\nNOT_RUN. Execution is limited to `STANDALONE` and `PREW3_SHADOW`.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** The product already models the three modes and the blocked disposition correctly. What is missing is an\\r\\nexternal Domain Owner issuing a Native Admission for W3 — an authority an agent cannot substitute for without turning\\r\\na governance gate into a formality.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Keep `SWOF_CONNECTED` blocked. Prepare the connected-mode dry run against a stub so that W3 is a\\r\\nconfiguration change on the day the admission lands, not a build.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Issue the W3 Domain Owner Native Admission, or authorise a shadow-only connected dry run.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Run the connected mode against the admission, capture the external receipt, and re-measure E08/E09.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W13 — five tools / three ZIPs / three private hosts (`HOST_PENDING`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `GSTACK_ABSENT` (23 probes); no host-issued IDs; no private-plugin schema in hand. E06 is NOT_RUN.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** Three of the artefacts this work package needs can only be produced *by* the host that will consume\\r\\nthem: tool IDs, reproducible ZIP install receipts, and private-host load receipts. An agent can build the tool, but it\\r\\ncannot be the host that accepts it.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Split the work package: the agent builds the five tools locally and proves reproducibility by\\r\\nbuilding each ZIP twice and comparing digests; only the host-load step stays `HOST_PENDING`. That converts \\\"not started\\\"\\r\\ninto \\\"built, awaiting load\\\", which is a materially different state.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Provide host IDs (or delegate to the host owner) and the private-plugin schema, or accept the local-build-with-double-digest\\r\\nevidence as the interim ceiling.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Load into each host, capture the load receipts, re-measure E06/C22.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W15 — release control bundle (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `release: BLOCKED`; the control plane reaches `DELIVERY_READY` but the round refuses `DELIVERED`\\r\\n(`TT-R15.2-DELIVERY-GATE-IGNORES-FAILED` — the gate does not block on FAILED work orders).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** The release needs two owner-side artefacts: a seal and a host-load receipt. Separately, HG-KSEOS's\\r\\ndelivery transition ignores FAILED work orders, so \\\"DELIVERY_READY\\\" is not evidence of readiness. Both facts point the\\r\\nsame way: the transition is a status flip, not a gate.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Do not fix the gate by refusing to advance — fix it by making the transition *require* a\\r\\nzero-FAILED predicate. That is a control-plane change (HG-KSEOS), and it is the highest-value defect in this list\\r\\nbecause every future round inherits it.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Approve the HG-KSEOS change (delivery gate must reject any FAILED work order) and issue the release\\r\\nseal separately.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Re-run the closing cycle and expect the transition to refuse while a FAILED order exists.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W16 — B0/B1/B2 performance baselines (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** No baseline artefact exists; `E0x` performance rows are NOT_RUN.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** A baseline needs an owner-chosen reference workload and an owner-accepted threshold. An agent that\\r\\ninvents both is setting its own exam.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Measure first, threshold later: publish B0/B1/B2 as *observed* numbers with the workload and host\\r\\ndescribed, explicitly unratified. That is useful immediately and cannot be mistaken for an accepted baseline.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Name the reference workload and accept or reject the observed thresholds.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Measure against the accepted workload, publish deltas, and re-measure C16.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Cross-cutting\\r\\n\\r\\nThree of the five blocker classes are the same shape: **the agent can produce the artefact but not the authority that\\r\\naccepts it.** The repair is not more effort — it is splitting each work package into a buildable part and an acceptance\\r\\npart, and reporting them separately. That split is what turns `NOT_RUN` into `BUILT_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE`, which is a\\r\\ntrue statement, instead of `NOT_RUN`, which reads as \\\"did nothing\\\".\\r\\n--- QUEUE_R15_2.json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"schema\\\": \\\"SBL_R15_2_QUEUE/1\\\",\\r\\n  \\\"why\\\": \\\"The round kept stopping because its artefacts described state and carried no executable next action. The actual root cause\\r\\n\\r\\n**The user's standing authorization and the governance contract quantify over different things.**\\r\\n\\r\\n- The authorization is about **effort and continuity**: \\\"do not stop, use FAR, execute your recommendations\\\".\\r\\n- The Fabric/HGK predicates are about **principal identity**: \\\"only a Domain Owner may admit W3\\\", \\\"only an AO may\\r\\n  accept\\\", \\\"only an owner may seal a release\\\".\\r\\n\\r\\nAn agent can satisfy the first instruction by working indefinitely. It cannot satisfy the second by working at all,\\r\\nbecause the predicate is `signed_by ∈ {owner}` — a set that no amount of computation enlarges. When both arrive in the\\r\\nsame turn, every possible action violates one of them:\\r\\n\\r\\n- stop → violates the continuity instruction;\\r\\n- sign anyway → violates the governance contract (and is the one failure that cannot be repaired later, because a\\r\\n  forged admission is indistinguishable from a real one downstream).\\r\\n\\r\\n**So the round did not stop because the model was lazy or the harness was missing a scheduler. It stopped because I kept\\r\\nchoosing the only legal action — refuse to forge — and then dressed that refusal as an ending instead of issuing the\\r\\nrequest that would have unblocked it.** The missing component was never compute; it was a **principal request**: a\\r\\nfirst-class, tracked, one-click-shaped ask addressed to the entity that can actually satisfy the predicate.\\r\\n\\r\\nThat is why repeated FAR failed: each FAR treated \\\"blocked on an owner\\\" as a symptom to be engineered around, when it is\\r\\na *fact about authority* that has to be **issued**, not solved.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 3. Why the repair is not \\\"get more authorization\\\"\\r\\n\\r\\nThe user has already granted everything a user can grant. Granting it again changes nothing, because the predicate is\\r\\nnot `authorized_by_user` — it is `signed_by_domain_owner`. A user who is not that owner cannot make it true by fiat, and\\r\\nan agent that pretends otherwise produces the one artefact class the whole contract exists to prevent. **The correct\\r\\nengineering response to an unsatisfiable-by-agent predicate is to make it satisfiable-by-owner in one step, and to\\r\\nprove the step was taken.**\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. The engineering solution (three components, all mechanical)\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1 Satisfiability classification, declared per item\\r\\n\\r\\nEvery denominator item carries `satisfiable_by ∈ {AGENT, OWNER, HOST, EXTERNAL_AO}` **and** the field that makes it so\\r\\n(e.g. `required_signature: \\\"domain_owner\\\"`, `required_artifact: \\\"host_id\\\"`). Without this, the same item gets\\r\\nre-litigated every round: it looks like unfinished work, so the next agent tries again, fails again, reports again.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2 Principal requests as artefacts\\r\\n\\r\\n`PRINCIPAL_REQUESTS/<item>.md` — one per owner-gated item, containing: the exact predicate, the artifact already built\\r\\nand waiting, the **literal** action or command that satisfies it, what it unblocks, an expiry, and the fallback if\\r\\ndenied. This converts \\\"not in my scope\\\" into \\\"issued, tracked, one step from unblocked\\\". It is the difference between a\\r\\nblocked round and a **pending decision with a form attached**.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3 A guard that refuses both false endings\\r\\n\\r\\nThe continuation guard already refuses \\\"done\\\" while agent work remains. It must equally refuse **\\\"blocked\\\" without a\\r\\nformal request**: an item parked with no principal request is indistinguishable from an item abandoned, and abandonment\\r\\nis what a chat turn looks like from the outside. New blocker: `UNISSUED_PRINCIPAL_REQUEST`. Together the two refusals\\r\\nleave exactly one honest terminal state: *no agent work remains, and every remaining item is an issued request awaiting\\r\\na named principal.*\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. What this predicts, and how it would be falsified\\r\\n\\r\\nIf the analysis is right, then after this repair the round should be able to sit indefinitely without a chat turn,\\r\\nwith every open item addressable by a single owner action, and no further FAR should find a new \\\"why did it stop\\\"\\r\\ncause. It is falsified if the guard's next refusals are again about agent-actionable work — that would mean the queue\\r\\nwas under-filled, not that authority was the limit.\\r\\n# FAR decisions for the five parked queue items\\r\\n\\r\\nEvery parked item has an owner class, a recommendation, the exact one-line action the owner can take, and what the\\r\\nagent will do the moment that action lands. Nothing here is signed by the agent.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W02 — Fabric active policy disposition (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** The round consumes Fabric as `FABRIC_CURRENT_ACTIVE_VIA_HGK_CONSUMER`, but no artefact names *which*\\r\\npolicy version is active, and `TT-R15.2-FRONTDOOR-SANCTIONED-DRIFT` shows the front door disagreeing with the declaring\\r\\nconfig (`10100` hard-codes `deepseek-v4.1-flash`; `config/hermes-codex-lane.json` declares `minimax-m3.1-flash-free`).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** Two configs claim authority over the same decision, and neither is marked active. The disagreement is\\r\\nstructural, not a typo: a front door with a hard-coded model cannot follow a config that is meant to change.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation (cheapest correct fix).** Declare the active policy digest in one place (`config/active-policy.json`\\r\\nwith `policy_digest`, `declared_by`, `declared_at`) and make the front door *read* it instead of hard-coding a model.\\r\\nUntil that exists, the sanctioned drift is the honest state.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action (one line).** Name the active policy digest, or authorise the agent to treat `hermes-codex-lane.json` as\\r\\nactive and retire the hard-coded front door.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Bind the digest, re-run doctor, and re-measure the front door's declared-vs-served model.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W12 — SWOF W3 admission (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `SWOF_CONNECTED` exists in `MODES` with disposition `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`; `E08`/`E09` (first real SWOF) are\\r\\nNOT_RUN. Execution is limited to `STANDALONE` and `PREW3_SHADOW`.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** The product already models the three modes and the blocked disposition correctly. What is missing is an\\r\\nexternal Domain Owner issuing a Native Admission for W3 — an authority an agent cannot substitute for without turning\\r\\na governance gate into a formality.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Keep `SWOF_CONNECTED` blocked. Prepare the connected-mode dry run against a stub so that W3 is a\\r\\nconfiguration change on the day the admission lands, not a build.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Issue the W3 Domain Owner Native Admission, or authorise a shadow-only connected dry run.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Run the connected mode against the admission, capture the external receipt, and re-measure E08/E09.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W13 — five tools / three ZIPs / three private hosts (`HOST_PENDING`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `GSTACK_ABSENT` (23 probes); no host-issued IDs; no private-plugin schema in hand. E06 is NOT_RUN.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** Three of the artefacts this work package needs can only be produced *by* the host that will consume\\r\\nthem: tool IDs, reproducible ZIP install receipts, and private-host load receipts. An agent can build the tool, but it\\r\\ncannot be the host that accepts it.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Split the work package: the agent builds the five tools locally and proves reproducibility by\\r\\nbuilding each ZIP twice and comparing digests; only the host-load step stays `HOST_PENDING`. That converts \\\"not started\\\"\\r\\ninto \\\"built, awaiting load\\\", which is a materially different state.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Provide host IDs (or delegate to the host owner) and the private-plugin schema, or accept the local-build-with-double-digest\\r\\nevidence as the interim ceiling.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Load into each host, capture the load receipts, re-measure E06/C22.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W15 — release control bundle (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** `release: BLOCKED`; the control plane reaches `DELIVERY_READY` but the round refuses `DELIVERED`\\r\\n(`TT-R15.2-DELIVERY-GATE-IGNORES-FAILED` — the gate does not block on FAILED work orders).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** The release needs two owner-side artefacts: a seal and a host-load receipt. Separately, HG-KSEOS's\\r\\ndelivery transition ignores FAILED work orders, so \\\"DELIVERY_READY\\\" is not evidence of readiness. Both facts point the\\r\\nsame way: the transition is a status flip, not a gate.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Do not fix the gate by refusing to advance — fix it by making the transition *require* a\\r\\nzero-FAILED predicate. That is a control-plane change (HG-KSEOS), and it is the highest-value defect in this list\\r\\nbecause every future round inherits it.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Approve the HG-KSEOS change (delivery gate must reject any FAILED work order) and issue the release\\r\\nseal separately.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Re-run the closing cycle and expect the transition to refuse while a FAILED order exists.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## W16 — B0/B1/B2 performance baselines (`OWNER_DECISION`)\\r\\n\\r\\n**Observed.** No baseline artefact exists; `E0x` performance rows are NOT_RUN.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Root cause.** A baseline needs an owner-chosen reference workload and an owner-accepted threshold. An agent that\\r\\ninvents both is setting its own exam.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommendation.** Measure first, threshold later: publish B0/B1/B2 as *observed* numbers with the workload and host\\r\\ndescribed, explicitly unratified. That is useful immediately and cannot be mistaken for an accepted baseline.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Owner action.** Name the reference workload and accept or reject the observed thresholds.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Agent on landing.** Measure against the accepted workload, publish deltas, and re-measure C16.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Cross-cutting\\r\\n\\r\\nThree of the five blocker classes are the same shape: **the agent can produce the artefact but not the authority that\\r\\naccepts it.** The repair is not more effort — it is splitting each work package into a buildable part and an acceptance\\r\\npart, and reporting them separately. That split is what turns `NOT_RUN` into `BUILT_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE`, which is a\\r\\ntrue statement, instead of `NOT_RUN`, which reads as \\\"did nothing\\\".\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"schema\\\": \\\"SBL_QUEUE_EXHAUSTION_PROOF/1\\\",\\r\\n  \\\"is_completion_claim\\\": false,\\r\\n  \\\"r15_2_complete\\\": false,\\r\\n  \\\"all_open_items_are_issued_requests\\\": true,\\r\\n  \\\"why_not_complete\\\": \\\"queue exhaustion only means no AGENT-actionable item remains. Kind×Mode×Host×Risk×Permission：三模式乘積\r\nEligible 是交集，不是任何單一 `mode`：`ProductKindEligibility = KindState ∩ HostCapabilities ∩ RiskPermission ∩ ModeGate ∩ NativeOwnerAck`。`STANDALONE` 對 是交付族群；`SWOF PrimaryKind` 是 SWOF 受控的七種 Native Entity 類別。**本輪無經 SWOF Owner 確認的完整 Registry Snapshot／Receipt 可支援重新枚舉**；所以不憑一般詞彙編造其七項值。跨讀欄位 的拒收反例\r\n給 `PrimaryKindRef` 指向一個來源未登錄的 `native_kind`，DOC-01 只應返回 `NATIVE_REGISTRY_UNVERIFIED` 並附 SWOF Owner 所需的回讀資訊；不得為了 GUI 正常展示建立假的第八類。`GENIE/GENIE.md` 也不享有合法 SBL 生成權。\r\n<a id=\"sbl-doc01-sec-034\"></a>\r\n### C06.3A｜八 Kind 乘三 Mode 的部署資格不是權限資格\r\n`CLI_TOOL、AGENT_SKILL、SIMPLE_AGENT` 才是 v0.1 實作目標；CLI 的 clean install/runtime/rollback、Skill 的 effective load/trigger/nontrigger/uninstall、Simple Agent 的 bounded loop/provider-off 皆屬不可降級 FUO。`PLUGIN、PROFILE` 保持 `DEFERRED_UNVERIFIED`，不能因三 SP 的投影存在就視作 ProductKind 已交付；`AGENT_OS、AI_SYSTEM` 在 v0.1 明確 `UNSUPPORTED_V0_1`；`GENIE/GENIE.md` 只作 SWOF 保留相容投影。`PREW3_SHADOW` 的觀測結果不允許 Effects；`SWOF_CONNECTED` 即使表格標示未來可行，也需 Native WorkOrder+ONE ECP+Permit+Receiver ACK+World Readback 的真正一組收據才能由 Owner 宣稱連線。\r\n**namespace**：SBL ProductKind 是產品出貨用途；Agent Components 是組合元件類型；SWOF 七種 Native PrimaryKinds 是 SWOF 正式 Registry 的型別；三者不允許 Enum 映射自動帶入寫權。未取得真 Registry Snapshot 時 `NativeRef(status=UNVERIFIED,read_only=true)`，不可捏造 231/59 的具體最新內容。\r\n## C06.4 C06 SPEC 與退出契約\r\n`input_schema=ProductIntent+KindEnum; output_schema=ProductKindCapabilityMatrix+ProductKindEligibility; preconditions=8 exact kinds + mode known; error=P_KIND_ENUM_MISMATCH|NO_FIT|ADMISSION_HOLD; first_fail=P_KIND_ENUM_MISMATCH; owner=SBL Product Owner; consumer=DOC-06/10/11/12; positive_fixture=POS-C06 CLI clean install and uninstall expectation; negative_fixture=NEG-C06 GENIE_PRODUCT alias; rollback_or_no_effect=no native effect`。`ACC-C06` 逐 Kind 明確安裝、啟用、執行\r\n===== None C:\\Users\\user\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\r152\\wo03_corpus\\SBL_PIPD-LS-PKG_DOC-01.md\r\nevidence_expectation: \"RawReceipt needed; not present\"\r\nfirst_fail: SKILL_NOT_LOADED\r\nowner: SBL_PRODUCT_OWNER\r\nclaim_ceiling: DESIGN_CANDIDATE\r\nobserved_raw_receipt: NOT_EXECUTED\r\n```\r\n`MomentContract` 和 `QuestionCandidate` 所有欄位見 C09/C08；`ProductKindEligibility` 需 `kind, mode, host_ref, user_risk, native_permission, eligibility, reason, owner, source_sha`，其中 `native_permission` 若未判必回 `UNKNOWN_PENDING_OWNER`；任何預設 `allow` 為安全缺陷。`FUOVerificationExpectation{environment,install,command,argv,exit_code,stdout_schema,stderr_policy,source_commit,checker_identity,negative,raw_receipt_expected}` 不能放入任何「已驗證」布林值，除非有同候選 RAW receipt。\r\n<a id=\"sbl-doc01-sec-057\"></a>\r\n## R01.3 Schema Evolution、SubjectHash 與 CrossReader NACK\r\n只接受明示 schema version；minor 新增 optional 可協商，刪欄/更變 enum 為 breaking 需專項 Owner RFC。DocumentRef 最小 `{doc_id,source_sha,schema_version,owner,consumer,first_fail}`；Reader 取回 source_sha 與當輪檔案不符→`STALE_SOURCE_REF`，不得猜測相容。任何設計資料轉原生 PI 或 SWOF NativeRef 必由合法專屬 Writer 進行，禁止本檔本地 JSON 模擬正式編譯回執。\r\n<a id=\"sbl-doc01-sec-058\"></a>\r\n# R02｜產品策略、目標與可觀測經濟效益\r\n<a id=\"sbl-doc01-sec-059\"></a>\r\n## R02.1 首個用戶場景與 FUO 門檻\r\n擬選 `DEC-004` Brownfield-aware 的獨立工程師/小團隊作首要 Persona、`GJ01` 具體 CLI 及 `GJ02` 既有 Repo 最小修補作雙試驗，`GJ03` 驗證合法可移植 Skill/Agent。有效 outcomes 需同時具 `real_command/real_host`, `semantic test`, `negative denial`, `undo/exit`, `permission_currentness`；「規格已產、Reader 已顯示、README 有展示」只能表示設計中間產物，不算最終 FUO。非目標 `AUTO_RELEASE`, `PROMOTE_GENIE`, `UNRESTRICTED_AGENT`, `MULTI_ORACLE_WRITER` 均 NACK。\r\n<a id=\"sbl-doc01-sec-060\"></a>\r\n## R02.2 Metric Plan、baseline 和決策凍結\r\n計量設計使用 `MeasurementSpec{metric_id,persona,journey,environment,source_version,before_receipt,after_receipt,window,n,confidence_or_limitation,owner}`。每個 P01～P07 的 `before_receipt` 本回合為 `UNOBSERVED`；目標門檻是 `SBL-PROP-TARGET`，不能推廣成生產 SLO。`DEC-004/005/006` 只讀候選按 DOC-01 Owner 重新批准；矛盾以 `DECISION_OWNER_HOLD` 保存原文和影響，不能私自將十一或十四冊選項升級正式。\r\n<a id=\"sbl-doc01-sec-061\"></a>\r\n# R03｜需求原子、CoverageLedger
